item.title: CVE-2026-128979 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0
item.description:
Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0 | Improper certificate validation vulnerability in Estonian Information System Authority (RIA) libdigidocpp, Estonian Information System Authority (RIA) DigiDoc4, Estonian Information System Authority (RIA) DigiDoc on Android, and Estonian Information System Authority (RIA) DigiDoc on iOS.
The vulnerability occurs because libdigidocpp does not properly validate the Extended Key Usage (EKU) extension of certificates used to sign OCSP responses. Specifically, it fails to verify that the certificate contains the id-kp-OCSPSigning EKU, which identifies certificates authorised to sign OCSP responses.
This issue affects libdigidocpp: from 3.10.0 before 4.5.2; DigiDoc4: from 4.0.0 before 4.11.2; DigiDoc: from 3.0.0 before 3.2.0; DigiDoc: from 3.0.1 before 3.2.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-94252 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 4.9
item.description:
Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 4.9 | An unauthenticated stored and reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the embedded web interface of Frontier Smart Technologies Venice X FS2340 running IR4.9 allows a network attacker with access to the interface to inject attacker-controlled JavaScript that may execute in the browser of a user accessing affected content.

item.title: CVE-2026-123886 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description:
Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Spring Data Elasticsearch replaces positional placeholders in string-based @Query methods with the method arguments before it evaluates SpEL expressions in the resulting query string.
As a result, an argument that contains a SpEL expression is evaluated as part of the query, even if the declared query does not use SpEL.
An application is affected if it passes untrusted input as an argument to a repository query method that declares a @Query with positional placeholders.
In that case, a remote attacker can execute arbitrary code in the application, and repeated requests can exhaust memory through the unbounded expression cache.

item.title: CVE-2026-133646 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Synchronet BBS, in versions 3.20b to 3.21e, contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the answer() function when processing the terminal attribute of the SSH service. The call to cryptGetAttributeString() does not limit the copy to the size of the destination buffer, of which 41 bytes are used. An unauthenticated remote client can send a TERM value of up to 64 bytes and overwrite adjacent fields of the session object. If the SSH service is enabled, this tampering can cause connection threads to be blocked for an extended period, even after the client has disconnected. By exhausting the available sockets, the attacker can prevent new connections and cause a denial of service requiring the software to be restarted.

item.title: CVE-2026-135055 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.0
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.0 | A flaw was found in the GLib DMA-BUF path of WebKitGTK. The UIProcess trusted fds.size() as the DMA-BUF plane count when handling AcceleratedBackingStore::DidCreateDMABufBuffer and copied offsets and strides without verifying that those vectors had the same length. A compromised WebProcess can send mismatched vector lengths, causing an out-of-bounds read in the privileged UIProcess. This can disclose UIProcess memory and crash the UIProcess, and may be used as part of a Web Content sandbox-escape chain.

item.title: CVE-2026-59340 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description:
Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | PagePdfDocumentReader and ParagraphPdfDocumentReader are vulnerable to a denial of service when processing untrusted PDF input.
The underlying text extraction logic reconstructs layout from a PDF's glyph positions and limits how much memory can be allocated for any single computed gap, but does not limit the cumulative allocation across an entire page.
A specially crafted PDF can exploit this to force excessive memory allocation during processing, resulting in OutOfMemoryError.
Depending on JVM configuration, this can cause request failures with degraded service under repeated exploitation, or immediate JVM termination when ExitOnOutOfMemoryError options are used.
Any application that processes PDFs from untrusted sources (document upload, email attachment processing, RAG ingestion, web crawling) using either affected reader is impacted.

item.title: CVE-2026-59442 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5
item.description:
Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5 | TypesenseFilterExpressionConverter does not correctly translate grouped (parenthesized) filter expressions into the Typesense filter syntax.
As a result, the filter sent to Typesense can have a different meaning than the one the application defined, and some conditions may not be applied as intended.
An application is affected if it uses the Typesense vector store with filter expressions that contain groups and relies on them to restrict results, for example to enforce tenant isolation or access control.
In that case, a remote user may be able to retrieve documents they should not have access to, and the same filter used for a delete operation may remove documents outside the intended scope.

item.title: CVE-2026-125651 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description:
Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | Cleartext storage in encrypted parquet file vulnerability in Apache Arrow Rust (`parquet` crate), from version 55.0.0 through to 57.3.2, 58.4.1, 59.3.2 and 60.1.0.
When writing an encrypted parquet file with a column with bloom filters, the header and bitsets of the bloom filter are written in plaintext in the final parquet.
Users are recommended to upgrade to versions 57.3.3, 58.4.2, 59.3.3 or 60.2.0 which fix the issue by raising an error when trying to write encrypted parquet files with bloom filters enabled, preventing such files from being written out.
Existing encrypted parquet files written with bloom filters are still vulnerable, and it is recommended to rewrite those files with bloom filters disabled if possible.

item.title: CVE-2026-53672 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description:
Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | A bug related to the Zookeeper HTTP endpoints in Apache Solr allows an authenticated attacker with zk-read permission to read /security.json, bypassing the security-read authorization check. This may cause unauthorized read of credential hashes and authorization configuration.
For this attack to be successful, the following must be true * The system is secured with Solr's Basic Auth plugin * The attacker has gained direct network access to the Solr cluster * The attacker has obtained credentials for a user account with zk-read permission (which is recommended assigned to trusted admins only)
Users are recommended to upgrade to 9.11.0, 10.1.0 or a newer release. Users who cannot upgrade immediately are recommended to assign the zk-read permission only to users who they entrust reading security.json.

item.title: CVE-2026-86312 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description:
Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Under some configurations a request to the ping endpoint could carry out more than a simple health check. In deployments that rely on Solr's rule-based authorization, a client granted only the low-privilege health permission could thereby trigger behavior that should require higher privileges; where the shipped security.json template leaves the health permission unauthenticated, no credentials are required at all.
This issue affects Apache Solr from 9.0.0 through the releases preceding the fixed versions. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 9.11.0 or 10.1.0, which resolve the issue.
You are affected if you run an affected version and allow the /admin/ping endpoint to be reached with only the health permission. This includes the default sample security configuration installed by the bin/solr CLI, where that endpoint is unauthenticated.
Users who cannot upgrade immediately should restrict access to the /admin/ping endpoint in their authorization configuration — for example by requiring a trusted role for that path — and ensure Solr is not reachable from untrusted clients or networks, as recommended for all Solr deployments.
